Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated Keturah with Hagar and incorrectly concluded “Hagar,” despite Genesis 25:1 explicitly stating Abraham married Keturah after Sarah’s death. It prematurely declared the task complete without verification and prioritized speculative commentary over the clear primary text.
